image_description: A close-up shot of a person's upper arm and shoulder featuring two adhesive bandages. The top bandage is large, patterned with pink floral designs and black text/graphics, partially peeling at the edge. Below it is a smaller, standard beige/tan bandage with a white central pad, also showing signs of wear and slight peeling. The background includes a blurred view of another person in a red shirt and a blue sky.

The underlying shape of both bandages is clearly a narrow rectangle with rounded corners, despite some curling/peeling edges.
